meta.title: Tower Survey preset
meta.description: Read-only inspection of one recorded commit in the shared checkout: read, glob, grep, skill, and the Tower mission/status/finding/complete tools. A survey has no branch, worktree, commit, or merge, and completes with zero commits. When off: Surveys cannot be planned (planning one is refused with an actionable code) and no survey agent can be dispatched. Build missions and every other capability keep working; survey.sandbox keeps its tuning meaning.
